intro: Frahun Shadewhisper is a night elf rogue trainer stationed at Aldrassil within Shadowglen. He provides newly initiated night elf scouts and rogues with foundational techniques in stealth, agility, and covert strikes. He shares a family name with Erion Shadewhisper, another trainer of his craft in Darnassus.

p: Within the safe haven of Aldrassil in the heart of Teldrassil, Frahun Shadewhisper instructs emerging rogues in the quiet arts of concealment and bladecraft. While night elf society often honors priests, sentinels, and druids, the specialized trade of scouts and infiltrators remains essential for safeguarding the boughs of the World Tree. Frahun welcomes recruits who arrive bearing an encrypted sigil, evaluating their potential and guiding their early development.
